summary.text: Jill Krowinski, a Democrat from Burlington, represents Chittenden-16 in the Vermont House of Representatives and is Speaker of the House.
She was elected Speaker on January 6, 2021, as the 92nd Speaker and the fourth woman to hold the post.

paragraphs.text: Krowinski has served in the House since 2012 and was elected House Majority Leader in 2017, according to her House biography.
She is a graduate of the University of Pittsburgh.

She has worked at non-profits, including as Executive Director of Emerge Vermont and earlier at Planned Parenthood of Northern New England, where her last role was vice president of education and Vermont community affairs.
She has also served as a commissioner of the Fletcher Free Library, vice chair of the Health Care Oversight Committee and chair of the Vermont Child Poverty Council.
Krowinski chairs the Joint Rules Committee and is vice chair of the Joint Legislative Management Committee.
